summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by foreign private issuer Tenaris S.A. announcing the availability of its First Quarter 2026 results conference call, with newly appointed CEO Gabriel Podskubka and senior management. The filing contains a cautionary statement regarding forward-looking statements and directs investors to the company's investor relations website. There are no transaction terms, deal structures, or special-situation events described. This is a routine earnings-related communication, not a special situation.
